result.topic_en: Tables of numbers n for which n^2+1 has only prime factors up to 97 (listed by their distinct prime factors, and grouped by largest prime), plus a list of runs of three consecutive integers with small prime factors under the heading 'Logarithmotechnia'.

methods.what: Factorization table: values n such that n^2+1 factors only into primes ≤ 97, with the distinct prime factors listed (e.g. 682^2+1 = 5^3·61^2)
Additional entries of the same kind (n^2+1 smooth over primes ≤ 97)
For each prime p ≤ 97 (of form 4k+1, and 2), the list of n for which p is the largest prime factor of n^2+1 (e.g. 239^2+1 = 2·13^4)
Runs of three consecutive integers composed of small primes, for computing logarithms (logarithmotechnia)
